ConnectionStrings._comment: Set ConnectionStrings__NpgsqlConnection env var with your PostgreSQL connection string.

_comment_connection_token: HMAC key MUST be set via FISHMMO_CONNECTION_TOKEN_HMAC_KEY_BASE64 or FISHMMO_CONNECTION_TOKEN_HMAC_KEYS env var. Keys must never appear in appsettings.json.
_comment_key_id: KeyId MUST be set via FISHMMO_CONNECTION_TOKEN_KEY_ID env var.
